title: Chapter 466
text:
Aesop coughed and said, "You won this game, but I don't want to see Ames. Black Star, can we discuss this?"

Han Xiao suppressed his killing intent and said with surprise, "You don't want to see your own disciple that much?"

"Back then, I just casually adopted a little girl, spent some time with her, and taught her how to awaken her Super talent. How would I know that she would become a Beyond Grade A Super whose name would shake the entire Star Field?" Aesop shook his head and said, "If I had known, I wouldn't have adopted her. With her strength, if I were to get entangled with her, I definitely wouldn't have been able to escape. Those days of losing my freedom are like being in jail. Just thinking about it makes me want to die."

Han Xiao's mouth twitched. Casually adopting a little girl and becoming a top Super many years later, why did it sound so familiar?

This old man even had an unwilling look on his face. Hey, I'll allow you to act cool, but don't go overboard!

Suppressing his desire to complain, Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and asked, "Since you don't want to see her, why did you come back?"

Aesop did not have the self-awareness of having lived for countless years and said like an old child, "The more she wants to find me, the more I want to appear in front of her."

His personality was as bad as ever …

Han Xiao was speechless. In his previous life, Aesop had always been wandering around and was a mysterious merchant in the eyes of the players. Until one day, he was involved in a dispute between two Star System civilizations and played a 'game' as usual. However, Aesop failed, and this time, his life was taken away. Even until his death, he did not meet Ames. After hundreds of years of searching, Ames only saw Aesop's tombstone in the end.

Ames did things based on her preferences, and this time, she was even more impulsive. She smashed all the planets of the two civilizations, including their mother planets, and caused countless deaths. The survivors who survived complained to the three Universal Civilizations that such a violent act violated the Order Treaty. Thus, Floating Dragon no longer had any privileges and was surrounded by a large number of troops.

At that time, a large number of players accepted the mission and participated in the encirclement.

Countless battleships exploded in this battle, and Floating Dragon Island also fell apart, becoming a meteorite belt. Although Ames did not die in battle, she disappeared from everyone's sight …

The famous Beyond Grade A Supers in the Shattered Star Ring had also changed over and over again with the passing of time.

Of course, that was a very late version.

But now, Aesop was caught by him. If he allowed Ames to meet him, this was something that had never happened in his previous life. He didn't know what would happen.

However, two civilizations with a population of hundreds of billions were massacred, Floating Dragon was destroyed, and Ames was severely injured and missing. This series of tragedies should not happen again.

"Forget it, I owe her a favor. I'll just hand him over to Ames. Killing him will only bring unnecessary risks."

Shaking his head, Han Xiao put away his killing intent. Aesop was indeed powerful, but he was not someone to be trifled with.

Aesop was only able to predict a small area within a certain period of time, but what he had grasped … was the general trend!

There was no need to be afraid at all!

Han Xiao wrapped his arm around Aesop's shoulder and whispered into Aesop's ear, "Don't worry, Aesop.

"I refuse."

Aesop's expression froze. How could he have said it so softly? He had been looking forward to it for nothing.

Han Xiao opened the communicator and contacted Ames. As soon as the call connected, Ames saw Aesop beside Han Xiao. Her beautiful eyes sparkled, and a playful expression appeared on her face.

"Aesop, my teacher, I miss you so much."

Aesop smiled bitterly. From Ames' tone, he could hear a strong sense of dissatisfaction. Even without foresight, he knew that he was in a bad situation.

After hiding for so many years, who knew how much resentment Ames had accumulated? It would be terrible for him to fall into her hands.

Then, Ames turned to Han Xiao and said, "Wait for me, I'll be there soon!"

After saying that, the screen turned black. Swift and decisive.

Aesop looked at Han Xiao with a depressed expression.

"Are you really not going to reconsider?"

"She has already seen you. Do you think I will still let you go?" Han Xiao chuckled.

Not long after, Ames' spaceship arrived at the port. She had just arrived in Noriose that day. Han Xiao brought Aesop to the port. Ames saw him the moment she got off the spaceship and walked over aggressively. Her aura was at least ten stories high!

Han Xiao grabbed Aesop's shoulder and could clearly feel the old man's body trembling.

"Dragon Emperor?"

This time, the passersby near the port were shocked and quickly retreated far away. They did not expect the top expert of the Shattered Star Ring to suddenly appear.

"Shouldn't you say something to me?"

Ames was expressionless.

Aesop sighed and said helplessly, "Alright, I should have come back to see you long ago. I shouldn't have avoided you. Don't stand here and be watched. Let's go."

As he spoke, he stepped onto the ramp. Before entering the spaceship, he turned around and glanced at Han Xiao. Suddenly, a smile appeared on his face.

Ames was about to return to the ship when she suddenly thought of something. She turned around and looked at Han Xiao. She paused for a moment before speaking with a serious tone.

"Thank you."

Han Xiao waved his hands and said, "It's a small matter. I've returned the favor."

"No, I owe you."

Ames' tone was unquestionable. Suddenly, she hesitated and slowly reached out. Her black sleeves slid down her smooth forearm, revealing her slender palm. She patted Han Xiao's shoulder.

Actually, she was a clean freak and was never willing to touch others. This time, she made an exception.

Although she did not show it on the surface, she was actually very happy. Therefore, she was very grateful to Han Xiao for capturing Aesop. She knew how cunning Aesop was. She had tried to find his whereabouts before, but she was always disappointed. The success this time surprised her.

Ames quickly retracted her hand, turned around, and walked into the spaceship. Han Xiao did not have much of a reaction. He suddenly thought of something and hurriedly used a blank Character Summon Card in the interface. Before Ames closed the door, her Character Summon Card was generated.

Boom!

The spaceship left the port with a rumbling sound and soon disappeared into the universe.

Han Xiao was still at the dock. He had already informed the others, and they all rushed over upon hearing the news. They all looked at the spaceship that was leaving, and Herlous asked, "Black Star, we're done. Where are we going now?"

"Let's rest in Noriose first. We'll leave tomorrow." Han Xiao turned around and looked at Wilsander. "Do you want to move with us?"

"I'm not in a hurry to go back. Plus, it's too boring to stay on Floating Dragon Island. Hehe, looks like I'll have to disturb you for a while." Wilsander gave a standard smile.

"As long as you don't spend my money, you can disturb me for as long as you want." Han Xiao shrugged.

At this time, there was a commotion in the hall. A group of Noriose upper echelons heard the news of Ames' arrival and hurried over. They did not dare neglect such a big figure. However, Ames left immediately after picking up Aesop. The whole process took only a few minutes, and these upper echelons of the financial groups were all left empty-handed.

The upper echelons of the financial groups then turned around and found Han Xiao. They smiled warmly and chatted with him.

Now that the Dragon Emperor had left, they could not come here for nothing. Thus, they decided to get in touch with Black Star and see if they could provide any help to show Noriose's attitude.

Originally, when Han Xiao first came to Noriose, the upper echelons of the financial groups only paid a little attention to him and got their subordinates to greet him. However, with the appearance of the Dragon Emperor, the situation was completely different. They felt that they had to greet him personally to show their sincerity. These upper echelons of the financial groups treated Han Xiao much more seriously.

While they were chatting, orderly footsteps could be heard not far away. Everyone subconsciously looked in that direction.

They saw a group of Godora people wearing battle suits hurriedly walking through the hall. They seemed to have just arrived, and the person leading them looked extremely valiant.

"Godora people? What are they doing here? " Han Xiao's gaze was also attracted. He looked curiously at the person leading the group of Godora people, and his expression suddenly changed.

He knew this person!

This was a Grade A Super!

…

On Ames' spaceship, Aesop stood in front of the porthole and silently looked at the Noriose that was gradually disappearing.

"What are you looking at?" Ames asked behind him.

Aesop retracted his gaze and revealed a satisfied smile.

"You have a pretty good officer. He is trustworthy."

"Are you talking about Black Star?" Ames nodded. "He is indeed very capable. Didn't you meet him long ago? You even asked him to pass a message to me."

Aesop paused for a moment, shook his head, and laughed.

"I'm old now. I almost forgot about this."

As he spoke, Aesop lowered his head, opened his communicator, and deleted a message that he had set a timer to send. The original target was actually Ames, who he had blocked all communication requests from.

Aesop shook his head helplessly.

"If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have come to the Shattered Star Ring and walked right into your trap …"

Aesop understood Ames too well. She was capricious, reckless, and not good at scheming. Just like what Black Star had asked, if he did not want to be found by Ames, he could have just stayed far away. There was no need for him to come to the Shattered Star Ring.

As for his motive, it was naturally not to tease Ames. Although he was indeed tired of living, his taste was not that boring. His target was obviously Han Xiao!

Someone had used his name to fool Ames. What if this person had found out about Ames' weakness and deliberately approached her with it, but was actually an enemy with ill intentions?

Aesop was very worried about this.

No matter what kind of achievements Ames had now, in his eyes, she would always be that little girl who needed someone to take care of her.

Therefore, he returned to the Shattered Star Ring and exposed his whereabouts, attracting the investigation of Ames' officers. If Han Xiao did not catch him, this person was just so-so. If he caught him, it would be a new round of Aesop's tests. He had already prepared for this, purposely showing off his foresight ability and setting up a series of traps to anger the other party. If Black Star was really the Dragon Emperor's enemy, he would not allow such a dangerous enemy to live.

If he died, the timer that he had set up would be able to remind Ames of his death. Whoever lied to her would be the murderer.

Aesop was testing the risk with his own life. If he died, Ames would not trust others so easily in the future. He felt that it was worth it. After living for so long, the habit of seeking death was already in his blood, and it only made him feel excited.

Although he was stubborn on the surface, he actually cared a lot about Ames. Aesop did not have any children, so Ames was like his adopted daughter.

Han Xiao naturally did not know that the casual words he said to persuade Ames back then on Floating Dragon Island would actually cause such a butterfly effect, allowing the two of them to reunite for the first time, indirectly changing the fate of hundreds of billions of people.

Black Star … Aesop thought. He has a lot of potential. If he lived for a thousand years like me, he would be a hundred times scarier than me.
